title: When life gets loud, God doesn’t shout back—He whispers.
paragraphs:
When life gets loud, God doesn’t shout back—He whispers.
The real miracle happens when we finally quiet our soul long enough to hear Him.
Pause… breathe… listen.
He’s been speaking to you all along.
“Be still, and know that I am God.” — Psalm 46:10 (KJV)
